frame.note: row4: the stack's audit row 4 weights; the case's per-head lines are charged at this union count

finite_removal_at_2s.note: engine operating lines only; the capital return's long-run subfunction responses and row 8's finite factor are not re-read
engine operating lines only; the capital return's long-run subfunction responses and row 8's finite factor are not re-read

part1_at_published_count.not_computed: the lineage's added people are counted on the account's frame (audit row 4) only

rules.property_taxes: modeled_owner_property on the account's CPS key (profiles_sept29.py; published-share gate); tenant_occupied_property on ACS contract rent and personal_property_tax on ACS household vehicles (per-person rates by age x the frame's headcount; kappa = the measured share over the standardized one); factor R
rules.housing_enterprise_surplus: its national over housing_subsidies' national x housing_subsidies' amount at (A, U); factor U
rules.state_price: the parent's amount at (A, G) x the line's amount over the parent's at GG; 0 at U = N
rules.roads_vmt: the case's amount x the group's persons 5+ at national ages over its own at A = N; 0 at U = N
rules.national_scale: a scaled line's uncorrected cell is model.json's x (payload national / model.json national)

rules.added_people: meta.lineage.counts.added placed at the identified G3+'s ages (g3plus_ages_oct07.csv's g3plus column: convention a, the ASEC person weights, this lane's bins); every row-4 union key vector is scaled by (union + added) / union in each bin, so the added people carry the union's per-person key at their ages; the lineage's own amounts (its edits) enter through each line's kappa, as the corrections do; the published frame stays model.json's
rules.justice: the added people's keyed parts at the union's relative risk theta on the row-4 frame (theta held)
rules.pension_accrual: social_security = the group's ratio (the case's amount over its OASDI receipts) x the OASDI receipts at (A, R); medicare's Part A accrual = part_a_accrual_bn + the lineage's set Medicare less (1 - part_a_share) x its cash Medicare; the tax on current benefits = benefit_tax_receipt_bn + the lineage's cash less its set federal income tax
rules.lane_constants: the lineage's edit is the added people's own (0 at U = N), as the line's amount beyond row 8; at U = N row 8 is c x v5's row8_factor (row8_in_lineage gives the part of the edit that is G3+'s share of row 8)
rules.finite_removal_note: the linearity note's 2s is twice v5's group share (meta.lineage.s.v5)
rules.part1_at_published_count: not computed: the lineage's added people are counted on the account's frame only

rules.added_people: beside the case: v5's rule, the added people at the identified G3+'s ages rather than the measured mix the case prices them at
rules.edit_sets: each item edit enters as the payload's other corrections do: a cell shift through its line's rule (kappa on a profile line: the group's own measurement, moving the amounts at U = G and none at U = N; a synthetic line's own rule), a national-scale edit through its line's uncorrected cell (natScale, every state); the parts named lineage_* (the added people's) join the lineage's own amounts on the accrual lines (v5.rules.pension_accrual)
rules.carriers: an item's carrier receipt line corrects the key of the component its offsets correct (of_component, a lines-keyed component): 0 at U = N; at U = G the case's value x that key's lines at (A, G) over at (G, G), kappa on the key; the offsets' returns join that component's line group
rules.split_basis: an item part whose split basis (the item meta's splits.split_basis) is a line other than the one it edits stays on its line, at that line's response, and takes the basis line's age profile as a correction on that line enters it (0 at U = N; at U = G the basis line's uncorrected amount at (A, G) over at (G, G)); its cost joins the basis line's group (education_services: schools and colleges by the school fraction) [ASSUMPTION, the case's splits rule]
rules.pension_inputs: none: the cash set has no pension accrual

split_basis_edited_line.rule: beside the case: each item part on a model line on that line's rule instead of its split basis (Pell on other_federal_benefits' all_cash profile and line group; the parts on payload lines keep their split basis), the same run's decomposition

rules.lineage_parts: R6-R9: all tagged lineage parts join the added people's amounts; the effective union pension amounts include R9's named shifts
rules.pension_identities: subtract R9's union pension shifts before comparison to meta.pension_accrual; the actual state calculations retain those shifts
rules.child_credits: receipt and refundable spending shifts are separate line groups, on their host lines' correction age profiles [ASSUMPTION]
rules.job_capital_taxes: all four responsive receipt lines form one line group, using the existing account-key age profiles [ASSUMPTION: no industry-by-age job-capital profile is measured here]

v8.coverage_execution: Coverage remains an additive post-engine item; source_parts expose its typed fiscal lines, capital return and signed P/F production split. Only its explicit unclassified remainder stays in post_engine_bn; source classification does not apply the coverage amount a second time.
v8.rule: sequential [ASSUMPTION]: measured base profiles held; item9 and item11 on receipt factor, item10 and item12 on use factor; no new age transport. At national profile completion and coverage counts cost the base's NNN per person, so the shared comparator includes every counted member. At group profile each own line group equals the exact item change.

low.unlocated_rule: M6 is a federal-income/refund/state-tax composite (round2.py54–58), and D_added transports Df+Dc federal-income/refund composite (removal.py381–390, round2.py71–73); neither identifies a single tax or benefit category. Consumption composite is assigned only to its known consumption-tax category, never split across individual lines.

high.unlocated_rule: M6 is a federal-income/refund/state-tax composite (round2.py54–58), and D_added transports Df+Dc federal-income/refund composite (removal.py381–390, round2.py71–73); neither identifies a single tax or benefit category. Consumption composite is assigned only to its known consumption-tax category, never split across individual lines.

v9.rule: [ASSUMPTION] Existing factor intervention and source age-key transport retained. Universal13/15/20/21 apply on every national state; equal-count national additions follow those same rules. Group-specific16/17, partial14 and repriced coverage enter on U; household basket18 on R. National college operating use takes its capital-key proxy without the original-group offset. No group-specific origin calibration, PES residual or mixed-unit solve is imposed on average residents. All are recorded separately.
